snippet.title: Detective Hindsight - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Watch the Demo Launch Trailer for Detective Hindsight, a mystery puzzle adventure game developed by Broccoli Bunny Studios. Players will investigate a unique cast of characters across a variety of unusual cases. Detective Hindsight is coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo available now for PC.
